name: cascade_delete
description: In DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey, the transaction explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer. This matches an application-level delete cascade, and it qualifies because GET /api/orders reads from `orders` (joined to `customer`), so deleting a customer permanently removes the order rows that that read endpoint depends on, causing missing/incomplete results.
